summary: NeuroOne Medical Technologies (NMTC) filed an 8-K disclosing the filing of a Prospectus Supplement under its existing Capital on Demand Sales Agreement with JonesTrading for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $13.4 million of its common stock. No price, premium, or specific terms are stated; the offering utilizes an existing registration statement (S-3). Honigman LLP issued a legal opinion on the shares. This ATM program allows the company to sell shares occasionally at market prices. Watch for sales volume and dilutive impact on stock.
